verdict.rationale: cfo.ai connects to payroll/HR systems (Gusto, Rippling) so Ari plans from those records, and it models hire scenarios ('a hire wave', 'what a hire does') within a driver-based cost and cash forecast. That implies planned hires flow into the expense forecast. However, no evidence shows a dedicated role-level headcount plan or an explicit reconciliation of planned headcount to payroll actuals. Missing for 10: documented role/position-level headcount planning, explicit tie-out of plan to payroll actuals, detail on how planned hires map into expense lines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
